desc: Leonard, in a pink shirt, sits on the sofa, reading a wine tasting book with a grimace.
Amy, in a brown sweater and pink shirt, opens her mouth in surprise while standing near the kitchen.
Leonard is outside the bathroom door and massages his belly with a pained face.
Amy's expressionless face suddenly shifts into a smug, close-lipped smile at the restaurant table.
Leonard, with a happy smile, in a Flash costume, answers the door.
Sheldon, in an orange shirt, looks down with a shy, pleased smile, at the comic store.
Upset Leonard, in a thick puffer jacket, takes champagne from the ice bucket in the hotel room.
Enthusiastic Sheldon, in a shirt with a colorful chevron pattern, points to the giant whiteboard behind him that he has set up in the apartment.
A shot of a stressed Sheldon looking up at the climbing wall from below.
Happy Sheldon, in a purple shirt, puts food from a frying pan down onto a plate.
Raj, in costume, smiling, raises his brown hammer.
Sheldon's eyes and mouth begin to twitch uncontrollably, while he wears a mint green shirt.
Pam is in a bathroom with her arms crossed, giving a worried and upset look.
Pam smiles as she sees a drawing of a printer pinned to the fridge.
Jim puckers his lips slightly, pressing them together, moving his head forward and down.
Michael is looking at a snake in a glass cage and making a disgusted face.
Michael, with a big smile, stands next to the tree in front of the window decorated with gold and red Christmas ornaments.
A close-up of Kevin looking down, anxious and nervous, mouth slack, blinds visible behind him.
Dwight stretches his interlocked hands out in front of the break room vending machines, stern and determined.
Phyllis in a floral shirt and cream sweater vest with a poinsettia smiles.
A close-up profile shot of Michael pinching the bridge of his nose, eyes closed, against a wood-paneled wall.
Darryl, at his office desk, drinks from a pink can with a disgusted expression.
A shot of excited Dwight sitting at a desk, surrounded by samurai armor, a sword, and a display case with a revolver.
Ryan smiles and scoops cash off his desk.
Michael lifts a baby carrier, holding it close to his chest with a serious expression.
Michael laughs while holding a yellow paper in his hand.
Pam talks on the phone, smiling flirtatiously, tongue slightly poking out, eyebrows raised.
Michael in a Santa hat looks alarmed as he holds up his hand wearing a pink oven mitt.
Jim holds up an old black-and-white photo, smiling.
Stanley stands in a long line laughing joyfully.
Pam, in a suit, looks secretly pleased, glancing sideways, a pink mug held in both hands.
Stanley stares in shock at a car covered in smashed watermelon.
Dwight claps happily, laughing widely with cheeks puffed at the reception desk.
Worried Dwight plays with the toy that he picked up from the desk.
Dwight cries, covering his eyes with his hand, sitting near an office window.
Michael, in a top hat and tuxedo, looks shocked, mouth open, eyes wide with disbelief.
Michael opens his mouth and eyes wide in joyful shock, holding a music player.
A bored Pam behind the counter rests her head on her hand.
Angela smashes Christmas ornaments in anger outside in the falling snow.
Andy walks into the office wearing gray coveralls, looking down with a defeated expression.
Dwight sits at his desk, seen through blinds, mouth wide open in shock, both hands resting on the desk.
Angela in a sweater with a Santa pin cries.
Michael stands beside a whiteboard, leaning on his umbrella, angry.
An outraged Angela, her mouth wide open, frantically grabs at her flying papers on the bus.
Michael, in a tan blazer over a graphic tee, raises his eyebrows with wide, alert eyes and an open mouth, looking startled.
A woman raises her hands like horns beside her head, sticking out her tongue with a playful expression by a fireplace.
Jim in a blue shirt looks stunned in front of a whiteboard.
Oscar sits on the carpet floor, touching a hole in it with a concerned face.
An outraged Dwight shouts with his mouth wide open on a street lined with lots of greenery.
Dwight drives a bus with a stern, angry expression, gripping the steering wheel tightly.
Michael sits at his desk squeezing a purple squishy toy, his gaze distant and blank.
Creed rubs his forehead with a pained expression at his desk, solitaire open on screen.
Michael scrunches his face, tears in his eyes, laughing hard.
Focused Dwight puts a bank card through a shredder.
A young man in glasses winks while leaning over the reception desk.
Andy, wearing a red cap and tie, stands next to the TV and winks.
Andy sits sideways at his desk with his legs crossed, thinking, with a shelf of office supplies behind him.
Jim stands next to internal windows with blinds, pointing at a taped note about a martial arts presentation, his face unfazed.
Darryl stands in the office glass doorway holding his mug, calmly yelling something with his mouth open.
Dwight scrunches his face and nods, agreeing reluctantly.
